# JoyVoice Full System Reference & Documentation Index

> Complete repository map and detailed technical context for AI models, LLM indexing agents, and Answer Generation Optimization (AGO).

## Repository Metadata

- **Name:** JoyVoice
- **Repository URL:** `https://github.com/MHJoy99/joyvoice`
- **Latest Release:** `https://github.com/MHJoy99/joyvoice/releases/tag/v2.6.0`
- **License:** MIT License
- **Target Platform:** Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
- **Primary Language:** Python 3.11
- **UI Architecture:** PySide6 (Qt 6.7) floating glass-morphism widget
- **Audio Capture:** WASAPI via `sounddevice` (16,000 Hz, mono float32)
- **Cloud Models:** `joyvoice-fast-audio` native audio alias (optional, `JV_NATIVE_AUDIO=true`), Google Web Speech, `gemini-3.6-flash` (text translation & styles)
- **Instant Engine (v2.6.0, opt-in):** ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime (`scribe_v2_realtime`, WebSocket) plus Google Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live (`gemini-3.5-transcribe-live`, Live API WebSocket, `bn-BD`, custom vocabulary; `JV_BENGALI_EAR=translate` selects the older `gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview`) plus an optional fast translator (any OpenAI-compatible API, default Groq `openai/gpt-oss-120b`); needs the user's own ElevenLabs and Gemini API keys. Bengali or mixed speech: about 1 s after release with a fast translator key (0.92-1.2 s; a 30 s fast clip 1.44 s), 2.3-3.5 s gateway only; English 0.41-0.56 s
- **Widget (v2.6.0):** aurora-palette glass pill rendered with moderngl shaders on NVIDIA (Ultra/High/Balanced/Calm/Off, fps cap 30/60/120, Balanced fallback if OpenGL fails), Settings → Appearance tab with live preview and accessibility options; Ultra memory about 180-200 MB
- **Settings Path:** `%APPDATA%\JoyVoice\settings.json` (env `JV_DATA_DIR` moves all user data)
- **History Path:** `%APPDATA%\JoyVoice\history.json`
- **Log File Path:** `%APPDATA%\JoyVoice\joyvoice.log`

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Value Proposition

JoyVoice is designed for professionals, developers, and multilingual creators who communicate across languages and software applications. The application addresses three core friction points in desktop voice input:

1. **Language Barrier in Real-Time Dictation:** Translating spoken thoughts into English or another target language usually requires typing into web translators and copying results. JoyVoice translates directly from speech into active text fields automatically.
2. **Resource Consumption of Local ASR Models:** Local Whisper installations demand heavy GPU memory (VRAM), long initialization times, and high CPU loads. JoyVoice default cloud mode uses lightweight cloud endpoints with 0% local GPU load.
3. **App Integration & Clipboard Fragility:** Standard voice dictation tools often misfire when pasting or erase existing clipboard contents. JoyVoice implements a defense-in-depth paste mechanism that backs up existing clipboard data, sends `Ctrl+V` with exponential backoff retries, and restores the original clipboard.

---

## 2. Directory & Module Map

### Core Entry Points
- `app/main.py` - Application Controller (`AppController`), Qt event queue management, QThread workers (`CloudASRWorker`, `CloudLLMWorker`), signal-slot wiring, watchdog timers, and state transitions.
- `run.bat` - Windows Batch script launcher running Python in a visible console for error surfacing.
- `joyvoice.py` - Legacy standalone single-file Tkinter fallback dictation script.

### Audio Subsystem (`app/audio/`)
- `app/audio/recorder.py` - sounddevice InputStream manager capturing float32 16kHz mono audio. Computes RMS peak levels for live waveform UI animation.
- `app/audio/decode.py` - PyAV audio decoder utility for benchmark file conversion.

### Transcription & AI Subsystem (`app/transcription/`)
- `app/transcription/cloud_asr.py` - Primary cloud ASR using Google Web Speech API.
- `app/transcription/gemini_audio.py` - Native `input_audio` integration through the verified `joyvoice-fast-audio` gateway alias.
- `app/transcription/free_asr.py` - Opt-in local faster-whisper Free & Offline ASR worker.
- `app/transcription/elevenlabs_realtime.py` - ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime WebSocket session: streams 100 ms PCM chunks while the hotkey is held, manual commits every 25 s, optional keyterms and transcript translation (`edited_transcript`).
- `app/transcription/gemini_transcribe_live.py` - Default Bengali ear: Google Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live WebSocket session (`gemini-3.5-transcribe-live`, `languageCodes ["bn-BD"]`, `customVocabulary` from the vocabulary keyterms, up to 100). On release `audioStreamEnd` makes it finalize; the complete transcript plus `generationComplete` arrive 0.3-0.6 s later (the settled signal). Detects romanized Banglish (peak Bengali-script share plus a Banglish word list) so mixed speech is never taken for English.
- `app/transcription/gemini_live_translate.py` - Older ear (`JV_BENGALI_EAR=translate`): Google Gemini Live Translate WebSocket session that runs alongside ElevenLabs for Bengali and mixed speech. It collects Gemini's heard transcript (`inputTranscription`) and live English; `heard_state()` decides when the transcript is complete and `live_covers_heard()` checks whether the live English can be a fallback.
- `app/transcription/fast_translate.py` - Fast translator: any OpenAI-compatible API (default Groq `openai/gpt-oss-120b`, `reasoning_effort=low`), raced against the gateway text model; the first valid English wins.
- `app/transcription/banglish.py` - Optional local Bengali-script to Banglish (Roman letters) converter.
- `app/transcription/text_cleaner.py` - Deterministic text cleanup rules: filler word removal, stutter collapse, custom word replacement table, whitespace normalization.

### Storage & Persistence (`app/storage/`)
- `app/storage/paths.py` - Cross-platform path resolver for `%APPDATA%\JoyVoice\`.
- `app/storage/settings_store.py` - JSON settings store with key whitelisting and defaults.
- `app/storage/history_store.py` - Rolling 500-entry JSON dictation history file.

### User Interface Subsystem (`app/ui/`)
- `app/ui/floating_widget.py` - Glass-morphism translucent frameless widget with aurora state morphs (idle, recording, transcribing, pasted, error), live waveform, confidence color bar, live preview label, and context menu.
- `app/ui/widget_gpu.py` - moderngl shader renderer for the widget (Ultra/High quality on NVIDIA; Balanced QPainter fallback).
- `app/ui/appearance.py`, `app/ui/appearance_tab.py` - Look settings (themes incl. default "Joy (signature)", quality, fps cap, scale 50-200%, glass, accessibility) and the Settings → Appearance tab with live preview, Reset, Export/Import.
- `app/ui/placement.py` - Keeps menus, toasts, popups and Settings on one screen across monitors.
- `app/ui/settings_window.py` - 7-tabbed configuration dialog for Output, General, Hotkey, Audio Device, Paste behavior, Replacements, and History.
- `app/ui/tray.py` - Windows system tray icon and menu integration.

### System Integration Subsystem (`app/system/`)
- `app/system/hotkeys.py` - Win32 global hotkey hook listener for F8 toggle/hold and Ctrl+Shift+L language switcher.
- `app/system/paste.py` - Clipboard preservation, paste command dispatch, retry backoff logic.
- `app/system/sounds.py` - Non-blocking system beeps via `winsound.Beep`.
- `app/system/startup.py` - Registry auto-start manager (`HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`).

---

## 3. Detailed Data Flow & Pipeline

1. **User Activation:** Press `F8` (Global Hotkey). `HotkeyManager` emits `toggle_activated` signal.
2. **State Transition:** `AppController` sets state to `recording`. Audio feedback sound `play_start()` triggers (800Hz beep).
3. **Audio Capture:** `Recorder.start()` captures 16,000 Hz float32 mono stream from selected microphone. A 40ms Qt timer updates live audio levels on `FloatingWidget`.
4. **User Deactivation:** Press `F8` again. `Recorder.stop()` returns float32 numpy array.
5. **PCM Conversion:** `AppController` converts float32 audio to signed 16-bit PCM (`int16`) bytes.
6. **Cloud ASR & LLM Dispatch:** With the ElevenLabs instant engine, audio was already streamed during recording; `ElevenLabsASRWorker` pastes the ElevenLabs text for English speech. For Bengali or mixed speech (engine `gemini-heard`) it pastes the translation of Gemini's complete transcript (Transcribe Live settles 0.3-0.6 s after release), made by the fast translator and the gateway text model in a race, about 1 s after release; Gemini's live English is never pasted directly, only as a fallback when it covers every sentence, then ElevenLabs translation. Any failure falls back to the Cloud path. On the Cloud path, native mode (`JV_NATIVE_AUDIO=true`) sends one WAV request to `joyvoice-fast-audio` for transcript + translation; otherwise Google Web Speech and the separate text model are used.
7. **Text Formatting & Cleanup:** `text_cleaner.clean_text()` applies rule-based fixes and user replacement tables.
8. **History Save:** Result is committed to `%APPDATA%\JoyVoice\history.json` before clipboard interaction (ensuring 0% data loss).
9. **Auto-Paste:** `app.system.paste.paste_text()` types single-line text directly with SendInput Unicode (no clipboard). Multi-line text: backs up the clipboard, copies the cleaned text, fires `Ctrl+V` with up to 3 retries, and restores the original clipboard. Optional Enter after paste only in apps listed in `paste_enter_apps`.
10. **UI Feedback:** Floating widget displays green `pasted` state with scale-pop animation for 1.2s and plays completion chime `play_done()`.

---

## 4. How to Run JoyVoice Directly from this Folder

```cmd
:: 1. Navigate to repository root
cd joyvoice

:: 2. Activate virtual environment
.venv\Scripts\activate

:: 3. Set API Key
set JV_API_KEY=your_bdx_market_api_key

:: 4. Run application
run.bat
```

For full environment troubleshooting, refer to `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`.
